court: In the High Court of Madras
prayer: Prayer: Civil Revision Petition is filed under Article 227 of the Constitution of India to allow the petition herein and direct the District Munsif Court, Tiruvottiyur to dispose of the O.S. No. 17 of 2026 within the time that may be fixed by this Hon'ble Court
judgment_text:
ORDER

Heard Mr. D. Daniel, learned counsel for the petitioner and I have gone through the records.

2. The petitioner seeks for expeditious disposal of O.S. No. 17 of 2026 on the file of the District Munsif Court at Tiruvottiyur. It is the plea of Mr. D. Daniel that the revision petitioner/plaintiff was not successful in getting the interim order also and on account of the said fact, the defendants are continuing their attempts to trespass and consequently, dispossess the petitioner.

3. The suit is of the year 2026. The plaintiff is aged about 53 years and hence does not fall under the senior citizen category too. Hence, no special circumstances exist for this Court to request the learned District Munsif for expeditious disposal of the suit. Nonetheless, as Mr. D. Daniel pleads that on account of the lack of the interim order, the possession of the plaintiff is being disturbed, the learned District Munsif, Thiruvottiyur is requested to take up I.A. No. 3 of 2026 in O.S. No. 17 of 2026 and dispose of the same within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

4. The civil revision petition stands disposed of on the above terms. No costs.
